def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    # Retrieve true state from bodies (not delayed sensor data)
    pole = sandbox.get_pole_body()
    theta = pole.angle  # True pole angle (radians)
    omega = pole.angularVelocity  # True angular velocity (radians/s)
    
    cart = sandbox.get_cart_body()
    x = cart.position.x  # True cart position (m)
    v = cart.linearVelocity.x  # True cart velocity (m/s)
    
    target_x = sandbox.TRACK_CENTER_X  # Use dynamically determined track center

    # Tuned control parameters for low-force environment
    Kp_angle = 0.2         # Proportional gain for pole angle
    Kd_angle = 0.1         # Derivative gain for angular velocity
    Kp_position = 5.0      # Proportional gain for cart position
    Kv_velocity = 0.5      # Velocity damping coefficient

    # Control law: balance pole angle and position
    # Positive angle implies pole leans right -> cart should move right
    # Position term pushes cart toward center
    force = Kp_angle * theta + Kd_angle * omega + Kp_position * (target_x - x) - Kv_velocity * v

    # Clamp force to actuator limits
    lim = CART_FORCE_LIMIT_NEWTONS
    sandbox.apply_cart_force(max(-lim, min(lim, force)))
